toegepas.rede_vinder: 'reis terug' after the noun is elliptical and wooden; the compound 'terugreis' is the natural Afrikaans form.
toegepas.fout: 'die maandelange reis terug' uses a trailing adverb as if it were part of a noun phrase, which reads wooden
toegepas.rede_keurder: The compound 'terugreis' is the natural Afrikaans noun, the meaning is unchanged, and the protected wording 'Baie het jare in die Ooste gewerk' stays intact.

toegepas.voor: Die seemanne het onder die dek gewoon en daar was
toegepas.na: Die seemanne het onder die dek gewoon, en daar was
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die seemanne het ... gewoon' and 'daar was min plek' each have their own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.blok: Min plek en werk in wagte

toegepas.na: Die werk is in wagte verdeel, en so was daar dag en nag seemanne aan diens op die dek.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hande op die dek' calques English 'hands on deck'; also adds the AWS comma between two full clauses.
toegepas.fout: 'hande op die dek' copies English 'hands on deck', and the AWS comma between two full clauses is missing
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'seemanne aan diens op die dek' says the same thing in natural Afrikaans, and the comma is required between the two clauses.

laat_vaar.blok: Min plek en werk in wagte
laat_vaar.voor: Die dissipline aan boord was hard.
laat_vaar.na: Die dissipline aan boord was streng.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Harde dissipline' is good Afrikaans and carries harshness, while 'streng' narrows it to strictness, so the meaning would move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'droog gepak' reads as 'packed dry'; 'gedroog' says the food was dried, parallel to 'gesout'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'droog of gesout gepak' reads naturally, and 'gedroog' narrows it to food that was dried, which does not fit hard biscuit as well as 'droog' does.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'die volgende' without a noun is elliptical; naming 'groep' makes the reference clear in an entry read on its own.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die volgende' clearly points back to ''n groep seemanne' in the same sentence, so the entry stands on its own, and a glossary definition should not be reworded for a lateral gain.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'wat kom' is vague and wooden for a definition; 'ontstaan' is precise and suits Grade 6.
na_skrywer.fout: 'wat kom' is vague for a definition
